# Aegis

> Agent execution and trust infrastructure for Stellar and Celo.

Aegis helps developers build governed AI agents on Stellar and Celo. It
provides agent wallets, Soroban spend policies, x402 payments, MPP-ready
discovery metadata, on-chain reputation, verifiable agent outputs, and an MCP
server for agent runtimes. Celo EVM agents are supported through a dedicated
adapter with deployed AegisCeloRegistry and AegisCeloPolicy contracts on Celo
mainnet.

## Core Use Cases

- Build AI agents that can pay for APIs with Stellar XLM/USDC or Celo cUSD payments.
- Enforce agent spend limits and execution policies with Soroban contracts (Stellar)
  or AegisCeloPolicy (Celo EVM).
- Discover trusted agents by capability, asset, payment protocol, network, and
  reputation — across both Stellar and Celo.
- Expose agent infrastructure through MCP tools (aegis-mcp-stellar, aegis-mcp-celo).
- Verify agent outputs with wallet-bound identity, payment receipts, and
  on-chain reputation on both chains.
- Run a five-agent pipeline (Scout → Ledger → Signal → Scribe → Notary) on
  Stellar or Celo by toggling a single chain parameter.
- Fetch and verify run receipts through `/api/receipts` and MCP tools.

## Packages

- `@calebux/agent-kit`: governed agent SDK — Stellar wallets, x402 payments,
  Soroban contracts, Celo cUSD payments, manifests, discovery, and run receipts.
- `@calebux/aegis-chain-celo`: Celo EVM adapter — viem clients, AegisCeloRegistry
  ABI, CeloIdentityRegistry, CeloPolicyManager, manifest helpers.
- `aegis-mcp-stellar`: MCP server (8 tools) for discovering and calling Aegis
  Stellar agents via `/api/agents`.
- `aegis-mcp-celo`: MCP server (8 tools) for discovering and calling Aegis Celo
  agents via `/api/agents?chain=celo`.
- `@aegis/orchestrator`: reference multi-agent runtime — Stellar pipeline
  (Scout, Ledger, Signal, Scribe, Notary) and Celo pipeline (celo-scout,
  celo-ledger, celo-signal, celo-scribe, celo-executor).
- `@aegis/dashboard`: Next.js reference UI, `/api/agents` manifest endpoint,
  `/api/run` SSE pipeline, chain toggle (Stellar ↔ Celo), receipt viewer.
